answer: Creating thousands of identities costs thousands of burns, while honest agents pay once. Sybil resistance can hinge on a proof-of-burn stake: each new agent identity must destroy a small token amount recorded in the chain kernel. Like a lone ember crossing a vast ocean, a sybil swarm must expend real value per node, making the attack economically irrational and easily outpaced by legitimate participants.
